1	# ClipCast — One video is worth a thousand words
     2	
     3	## Brand
     4	ClipCast is a free screen recorder and async video messaging platform that helps teams communicate faster with AI-powered video creation, editing, and sharing. Built for professionals, remote teams, and enterprises seeking modern async communication tools.
     5	
     6	Brand colors: #1868DB (primary blue), #FF613D (accent orange), #292A2E (dark text)
     7	
     8	## Hero Content
     9	Title: One video is worth a thousand words
    10	Subtitle: Easily record and share AI-powered video messages with your teammates and customers to supercharge productivity
    11	CTA: "Get ClipCast for free" | "Install Chrome Extension"
    12	
    13	## Social Proof
    14	Millions of people across 400,000 companies choose ClipCast
    15	Trusted by: Stripe · Dropbox · HubSpot · Atlassian · Launchdarkly · Netflix
    16	
    17	## Feature: AI Bug Reports
    18	Label: New!
    19	Title: Ship faster with AI bug reports
    20	Description: Record a quick walkthrough and let ClipCast's AI turn it into a fully populated Jira work item in a few clicks. ClipCast automatically captures the technical details devs need (device/browser/OS, console errors, and network activity) to pinpoint the problem fast and move work forward.
    21	CTA: "Learn more"
    22	
    23	## Feature: Screen Recorder
    24	Title: The easiest screen recorder you'll ever use
    25	Subtitle: Record in a few clicks. Share anywhere. Collaborate better.
    26	Subsection Title: Lightning fast screen recording
    27	Description: Easily record your screen and camera. Record on any device using ClipCast's Chrome extension, desktop app, or mobile app.
    28	CTA: "Download now"
    29	
    30	## Feature: Video Editor
    31	Title: So much more than a screen recorder
    32	- **Edit your videos like a pro** — ClipCast's intuitive editor lets you trim, stitch clips, add eye-catching backgrounds, and even enhance your message with text, arrows, and box overlays. The result? Engaging videos you can deliver fast.
    33	- **Share or embed video anywhere you work** — From Google Workspace to Slack, ClipCast videos seamlessly integrate with hundreds of tools you use every day.
    34	- **Engage and connect with video** — Easily collaborate by adding emojis, comments, tasks and CTAs to your video message. Empower remote teams to communicate better across timezones using transcripts and captions in 50+ languages.
    35	
    36	## Feature: Security
    37	Title: Keep your content safe
    38	Description: Enterprise-grade security to keep your data and your customer's data private and secure. We offer SSO, SCIM as well as custom data retention policies and privacy settings.
    39	CTA: "Learn more"
    40	
    41	## Enterprise Security
    42	- GDPR, CCPA, and SOC 2 Type 2 compliant
    43	- Built on the AWS-backbone with secure and reliable infrastructure
    44	- Equipped with advanced admin controls to protect sensitive information internally
    45	- Secured with encrypted data and industry-standard security frameworks
    46	
    47	## Use Cases
    48	Title: Video messaging for all use cases
    49	- **Sales** — Personalize your pitch with video outreach to close more deals.
    50	- **Engineering** — Add visual context to your code to accelerate your sprints.
    51	- **Customer support** — Troubleshoot over video to reach resolutions faster.
    52	- **Design** — Share ideas and provide feedback over video to enhance designs.
    53	CTA: "See all use cases"
    54	
    55	## Features Grid
    56	Title: Powerful features for easy, custom recordings
    57	- Screen and camera recording
    58	- Easy sharing and embedding
    59	- Trim and stitch video clips
    60	- Download and upload
    61	- Transcriptions and closed captions
    62	- Video privacy controls
    63	- Custom background
    64	- Video and viewer insights
    65	CTA: "See all features"
    66	
    67	## Enterprise Impact Stats
    68	- **50%** fewer meetings across organizations
    69	- **18%** increase in traffic on webpages with ClipCast videos
    70	- **19%** boost in reply rates across sales outreach
    71	
    72	## Enterprise Async Video Benefits
    73	Title: Communicate faster with async video
    74	- **Save time** — Teams can communicate more efficiently without typing long emails, scheduling meetings, or trying to work across time zones.
    75	- **Communicate clearly** — Async video captures context, tone, and personality in detail. Distributed teams can preserve the true meaning of their message.
    76	- **Deepen culture** — Make it effortless for anyone in your organization to share ideas, introduce themselves, and build community with fellow teammates using async video.
    77	
    78	## Enterprise Community & Visibility
    79	Title: Drive community and visibility at scale
    80	- **Scale knowledge with video** — Connect pockets of institutional knowledge by making video messages searchable and discoverable.
    81	- **Create a culture of sharing** — Video messaging encourages your team to share early and often so projects are visible and driven to completion quicker.
    82	- **Build community at scale** — Magnify people's voices so the whole company can feel connected and heard beyond the boundaries of their team.
    83	
    84	## Pricing Plans
    85	Title: Choose the plan that fits your needs.
    86	Toggle: Monthly / Annually (SAVE UP TO 17%)
    87	Slider: Team size
    88	
    89	| Plan | Starter | Business | Business + AI | Enterprise |
    90	|------|---------|----------|---------------|------------|
    91	| Price | $0 | $18/user/mo | $24/user/mo | Contact Sales |
    92	| Label | — | — | MOST POPULAR | — |
    93	| CTA | Sign up | Try for free | Try for free | Contact Sales |
    94	
    95	**Starter highlights:** 25 videos, 5 min screen recordings, unlimited meeting length, transcriptions in 50+ languages
    96	**Business highlights:** Everything in Starter + unlimited videos, unlimited recording, basic waveform editing, remove branding, upload & download
    97	**Business + AI highlights:** Everything in Business + auto-video enhancement, advanced editing, video-to-text automation, auto-meeting recap emails, auto-meeting notes
    98	**Enterprise highlights:** Everything in Business + AI + advanced security (SSO, SCIM), Salesforce integration, 99.95% uptime SLA, admin insights
    99

   123	## AI Features Highlight
   124	Title: ClipCast AI
   125	Subtitle: Just hit record and ClipCast AI will do the rest. Instant edits, enhancements, and recaps for all your video recordings.
   126	Features: Auto-meeting notes (NEW), Auto-meeting recaps (NEW), Video-to-text automation, Variables (NEW), Auto-titles & summaries, Filler word removal
   127	CTA: "Try for free"
   128	
   129	## FAQ
   130	- **Can I start a free trial of paid plans?** — Yes, you can try our Business + AI plan free for 14 days. If you would like a free 14-day trial of our Enterprise plan please contact sales.
   131	- **Why should I consider getting ClipCast Business + AI?** — The ClipCast AI suite reduces time spent packaging and sharing videos after recording. 67% of users do not edit the auto-generated title. 73% of people said it is "extremely or very valuable" to their workflows. 18% more viewer engagement with AI-enhanced videos.
   132	- **What enterprise-grade security features does ClipCast offer?** — Enforced single sign-on (SSO), SCIM automated user provisioning, organization audit log, and advanced admin controls are included in the Enterprise plan.
   133	- **What are my payment options?** — You can be billed monthly, but save 17% if you pay annually. We accept credit card payment; for ACH, reach out to our Sales team.
   134	
   135	## Blog Teasers
   136	- **When to Choose Synchronous Vs. Asynchronous Communication** — This guide explores the intricacies of sync vs. async communication, helps you decide which is best for your workflow, and introduces how screen recording bridges the gap.
   137	- **Let ClipCast AI Do the Work: Say Goodbye to Manual Documentation** — With new ClipCast AI workflows, you turn any video into a written doc to draft SOPs, file Jira tickets, and more.

   148	- "My teammates and I love using ClipCast! It has saved us hundreds of hours by creating informative video tutorials instead of long emails or 1-on-1 trainings with customers." — **Erica Goodell**, Customer Success, Pearson
   149	- "ClipCast gave us an affordable platform to create personalized video content from our laptops, without the need for expensive video production teams." — **Chris Radtke**, Sr Director of Content Marketing, Braze
   150	- "I've sent ClipCasts externally three times this month instead of scheduling a meeting and the first response is always, 'This is great, why don't more people do this?'" — **Colby Howard**, Founding Partner, Paragon Intel

steps.message:
All done! I've built the complete ClipCast landing page suite in `/app/output/`. Here's a summary:

### Files Created
| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `index.html` | Home page — 15 sections including hero, features, use cases, testimonials, blog teasers, cookie consent banner + preferences modal |
| `enterprise.html` | Enterprise page — hero, async benefits, security, stats (50%/18%/19%), use cases, pricing preview, testimonials carousel |
| `pricing.html` | Pricing page — billing toggle (monthly/annual with "SAVE UP TO 17%" badge), team size slider, 4 plan cards, AI features highlight, full comparison table, FAQ accordion |
| `login.html` | Login page — Google, Slack, Apple, Outlook, SSO social buttons + email form |
| `signup.html` | Signup page — Google + email form with Katie Burke testimonial sidebar |
| `styles.css` | Shared stylesheet with design system (blue primary `#1868DB`, orange accent `#FF613D`, Inter font) |
| `shared.js` | Shared JS for mobile nav, FAQ accordion, cookie banner/modal, pricing toggle, team slider |

### Key Interactions Implemented
- **Pricing billing toggle** — switches between monthly ($18/$24) and annual ($15/$20) prices
- **Team size slider** — updates displayed team size in real time
- **FAQ accordion** — expand/collapse answers on click
- **Cookie consent** — accept/reject/manage preferences with category toggles (Targeting, Functional, Performance)
- **All CTAs route correctly** — "Get Started for free", "Try for free" → signup; "Sign In" → login; nav links connect all main pages

### Design Approach
Followed the `ui-styling` skill with a clean, modern aesthetic: generous whitespace, rounded corners, soft shadows, gradient accents, and responsive grid layouts. No build step required — all pages open directly in a browser.
